Desktop - Themes

  • feat(themes): implement themes-as-extensions Phase 1+2 — unified lifecycle and cmd palette switching (213b)

  • Themes are CSS-only extensions served via peek://theme/ protocol

  • Switch themes from command palette, auto-discovers installed theme extensions

  • Includes default "Peek" theme with bundled fonts

  • feat(theme): add 七十二候 micro-seasons theme with traditional Japanese colors (d031)

  • Colors change automatically every ~5 days based on Japan's 72 micro-seasons calendar

  • Uses 伝統色 (traditional Japanese colors) with automatic dark mode derivation via color-mix()

  • fix(themes): copy fonts to theme-peek extension and fix font URLs (da4b)

  • fix(editor): improve syntax highlighting readability in dark mode (de99)


Desktop - Groups
  • feat(groups): add workspace persistence — save and restore window layouts per group (1a25)

  • feat(groups): add quick wins — close, search scope, switch, pin (b8a6)

  • Close all windows in group, scope search to group, switch between groups, pin windows

  • test(groups): add unit tests for groups quick wins (805d)


Desktop - Widget System
  • feat(sheets): add widget sheet extension with freeform layout (9644)

  • feat(hud): migrate HUD to widget sheet system with individual widget pages (4ec6)

  • feat(extensions): add widget demo extension (7aeb)

  • feat(grid): add freeform layout mode with drag/resize editing (6f05)

  • New "freeform" viewMode for peek-grid — drag to move, edge-drag to resize, snap-to-grid


Desktop - Editor
  • feat(editor): add vim :set wrap/nowrap, :set number/nonumber, and :q command (4750)

  • feat(editor): persist vim :set settings (wrap, lineNumbers) across sessions (ab30)

  • fix(editor): support multiple simultaneous editor instances (a3be)


Desktop - Page View
  • feat(page): show loading indicator for in-page webview navigations (538f)

  • fix(page): rewrite loading indicator — separate lifecycle from visual effect (847d)

  • fix(page): ensure page loading glow clears when page finishes loading (1630)


Desktop - Entity Recognition
  • feat(entities): add Phase 1 entity validation framework (64f7)

  • test(entities): add unit tests for name-validator module (d81c)


Desktop - Tauri
  • feat(tauri): add system tray with click-to-show (c469)

  • feat(tauri): add net-fetch proxy and file dialog commands (83f5)


Desktop - Refactoring
  • refactor: extract shared modules to app/lib — pubsub, izui, frecency, shortcuts, session (da44, 9ff2, 10f0, e267, 7ed8)

  • Platform-agnostic implementations shared between Electron and Tauri backends


Desktop - Fixes
  • fix(drag): use !important CSS classes for hold/drag cursor feedback (6e86)

  • fix(sync): make sync now fire-and-forget + add 15s timeout (96ed, 73f9)

  • fix: handle macOS open command with local file paths (1ae8)

  • fix: prevent opening app directory as file:// URL on startup (e12b)

  • fix(ext): use Promise.allSettled for extension loading so one failure doesn't block all commands (d031)


Testing
  • fix(tests): resolve pre-existing unit test failures across 4 test suites (a961)

Desktop - Command Palette

  • feat(cmd): generic command chaining with pipe system (597)

  • feat(cmd): replace embedded chain editor with popup window system (572)

  • feat(cmd): add parameter suggestions to command palette (693)

  • feat(cmd): add noun registration API for declarative command generation (191)

  • fix(cmd): remove download cmd, fix save filename, fix dialog parent, unify hashtag extraction (5b95)

  • fix(cmd): preserve noun routing metadata in command registry pipeline (39a4)


Desktop - Entity Recognition
  • feat(entities): add observation frequency ranking — Phase 1 (803)

  • feat(entities): add thumbs up/down feedback for entity quality scoring (c0e)


Desktop - Tags
  • feat(tags): add rename and delete tag operations (ac2)

  • fix(tags): add protocol 404 logging, handle all item types, fix filter counts (403e)


Desktop - Display Switching
  • refactor(display-watcher): replace 3-phase algorithm with safety-net-only approach (afa)

  • Gutted 881-line 3-phase algorithm, replaced with 304-line single-pass safety net

  • Lets macOS handle display migration natively, only rescues genuinely orphaned windows


Desktop - Page View & Dragging
  • fix(page): filter Cmd+L/R/[/] pubsub by windowId so only active page window responds (657)

  • fix(page): fully end drag on webview mouseup to prevent overlay blocking clicks (a7b)

  • fix(drag): remove data-no-drag from extension window bodies to restore hold-to-drag (63c1)


Desktop - Auth & URLs
  • feat(auth): OAuth popup bridge and flow improvements (c93)

  • fix(url): wait for frontend ready and session restore before processing external URLs (e7ab)


Testing
  • test(cmd): add completer unit tests; fix tag # prefix stripping (610)

  • test(cmd): add integration tests for command execution through pubsub (e11)

  • test(cmd): add command chaining pipe system tests (566c)

  • test(oauth): add OAuth bridge unit tests (77b)

  • fix(test): fix 4 stale test expectations in desktop smoke tests (4d9)

Desktop - Session Restore

  • feat(session): implement full session save/restore system (Phases 1-4) (0e8afccd, f270c56d, d0150877, d2fb834a)

  • Phase 1: Snapshot all windows on quit (position, size, URL, mode)

  • Phase 2: Restore windows on startup with confirmation dialog

  • Phase 3: Autosave timer and manual session commands

  • Phase 4: Crash recovery dialog and error handling

  • fix(session): save settings windows, strip stale params on restore, fix display-watcher race conditions (d12bd2b9)

  • fix(session): suppress display-watcher during session restore to preserve window positions (c32b73df)

  • fix(session): handle SIGINT/SIGTERM as clean shutdowns to prevent false crash dialog (f56f5624, 8ab6d36d, 16a2d4bc)

  • fix(session): synchronous SIGINT save and correct canvas page bounds (2df8a733)

  • fix(session): open startup feature when restore is declined or fails (0f280143)


Desktop - Display Switching
  • feat(display): reposition windows when displays change (d732fa79)

  • Pre-debounce bounds capture preserves window positions before OS moves them

  • Group-based distance scaling for proportional repositioning

  • fix(display-watcher): add home display tracking to restore windows after display reconnect (60b0798d)

  • fix(display): use group-based distance scaling for window repositioning (11166190)


Desktop - Entity Recognition
  • feat(entities): show source pages in entity list and add detail pane with full metadata (12feb902)

  • fix(entities): improve detection coverage and reduce price noise (82b70037)

  • fix(entities): migrate out standalone price entities lacking product context (383202ae)

  • fix(entities): require context for date entities, migrate out standalone dates (6ada27ba)


Desktop - Command Palette

  • fix(cmd,perf): sort history by frecency, use targeted queries for URL lookups (0873e5ee)

  • fix(cmd): restore web page URLs in frecency suggestions (65baa072)

  • fix(cmd): ESC clears text first, Shift-Tab cycles backward, fix frecency tracking (8f6b41a8)

  • fix(cmd): register IZUI escape handler so ESC clears text before closing (80592eb0)

  • fix(cmd): remove prefix feedback that caused adaptive sort cross-contamination (5ceb0517)

  • fix(cmd): add deterministic tiebreaker to command palette sort for consistent autocomplete (566b63a8)


Desktop - Page View & Navigation
  • feat(page): replace fullscreen transparent window with minimal page host (c543e38b)

  • fix(page): restore webview drag with mousedown/mouseup bridge from guest page (63cd1414)

  • fix(page): remove broken click-through code that activated unrelated windows (10f29146)


Desktop - Window Dragging
  • fix(drag): rewrite window drag system v3 — unified, faster, works everywhere (5a7c7899, fa58f66b, 1f815b61)


Desktop - HUD & Groups
  • fix(hud): hide on app blur using did-resign-active (be05026c)

  • fix(groups): fix group creation via inline form (141829f7)

Desktop - Dark Mode & Settings

  • feat(websearch): add Kagi as built-in search engine (e7d05c94)

  • fix(settings): add descriptions and human-readable labels to core settings (0bfe87b9)

Desktop - Fixes
  • fix(mode,window): fix mode leak into global scope and bring existing windows to front (9b783b6b)

  • fix(shortcuts): silence spurious warnings when unregistering global shortcuts during shutdown (7941b5f6)

  • fix(cmd): ensure command registration after extensions loaded (3f9df015)

  • feat(components): add sorting and view modes to card grid toolbar (83a85332)

Testing

  • test(display-watcher): add tests for pre-debounce capture, suppress timer cancellation, and isRemoval flag (fd56204f)

  • test: add 94 new unit tests and fix 3 E2E test failures (2251f86f)

  • feat(websearch): implement web search extension with OpenSearch discovery and suggestions (bf488889)

  • feat(search): implement unified search extension (4b95973d)

  • feat(pagestream): implement vertical history stream extension (35f9afcc)

Desktop - Dark Mode

Desktop - Page View & Navigation

Desktop - Tags & Editor
  • feat(tags): embed editor in detail pane for inline note editing (a575013e)

Desktop - Shortcuts & Commands

  • Fix: Cmd+Q quit, Cmd+, settings (were incorrectly using Opt+)

  • feat(api): implement commands.list() to query registered commands via pubsub (696c7859)

  • fix(cmd): fix frecency/adaptive sorting in command palette (2f6da3fd)

Testing
  • test(history): add unified URL/history tests for unification refactor (d3ac05f7)

Desktop - IZUI Role-Based Redesign

  • Migrated peek-card, peek-grid, peek-list to shared peek-components

  • Unified ESC key handling across all window types

  • Fixed HUD test infrastructure

  • feat(izui): implement role-based window policy (Phase 1-2) (3fbcade9)

  • Replaced session-based transient/active detection with deterministic role system

  • Five roles: root, child-content, child-tool, hud, transient

  • Role assigned at window creation, governs ESC behavior and lifecycle

  • feat(izui): complete role-based migration (Phase 3-6) (8528f053)

  • Migrated all window creation sites to use role-based policy

  • Removed legacy IzuiStateCoordinator session tracking

  • ESC behavior fully determined by window role

  • fix(izui): promote content to child-content when opened from parent window (92d359c5)

  • fix(izui): promote transient session on app focus, fix startup role (055b77ed)


Desktop - Navigation & UI

Desktop - Command Bar

Mobile / iOS

  • fix(server): enable single-user mode for e2e tests (c6c249b5)

Desktop - IZUI (Inverted Zooming User Interface)

  • feat(izui): implement IZUI state machine for transient vs active window behavior (457ce41d)

  • Centralized IzuiStateCoordinator manages session-based state tracking

  • Fixes cmd bar stuck on "group" mode when invoked transiently

  • Fixes ESC from overlay showing groups instead of returning to previous app

  • Transient state propagates to child windows (cmd -> overlay)

  • Uses isFocused() for accurate system focus detection

  • KeepLive windows re-evaluate transient state on each show

  • Added api.izui.* renderer API for querying state

  • 54 unit tests with dependency injection for testability

  • See docs/izui.md for full documentation

  • fix(izui): OS-level focus for transient detection + graceful test shutdown (e1764328)

  • Transient detection uses OS-level app focus (app.isFocused) instead of window visibility

  • Tests use graceful app.quit() instead of SIGTERM/SIGKILL (no more crash dialogs)

  • 5 new IZUI behavior tests for real app focus scenarios

  • refactor(izui): passive backend window manager - extensions use api.window.open() directly (188894c4)

  • Backend no longer creates windows for extensions; extensions open their own via API

  • Simplifies window lifecycle and reduces coupling

  • fix(izui): child windows always close on ESC + center windows on screen (b0d07b89)

  • ESC policy: child windows always close, active root windows do not

  • All new windows centered on screen at creation

  • fix(izui): visibility-based transient detection + active mode ESC protection (d74b62b5)

  • feat(izui): center child windows over parent window (bd947dbc)

  • Parent window position/size used to calculate centered placement

  • Focus restored to parent on child close

  • fix(izui): renderer-driven escape lifecycle for navigate mode windows (dc470b7f)

  • fix(izui): fix ESC navigation, window drag, and navbar cleanup (3ca4841b)

  • item:created, item:updated, item:deleted events
